findings.title_text: Possible s.201(1A) interest on a 194C shortfall for one payee -- range pending deposit evidence
limits_text: Books/documents alone cannot establish the actual deduction/collection and deposit dates; challans, the TAN and (for the pre-deduction leg) Form 26A are needed before any single interest amount can be confirmed -- this is a range, not a computed liability.
ask_client_text: Provide TDS/TCS challans and the TAN to confirm actual deduction/collection and deposit dates for this payee.
If not deducted/collected, confirm whether Form 26A (or the equivalent TCS relief) is available, and the payee's own return-filing date.
